mentions.name: CiteLLM
mentions.description: This API extracts structured data from PDFs and returns citations for each extracted field, including page number, coordinates, source snippet, and confidence, so every value can be verified by linking it back to its exact location in the original PDF.
mentions.problem: LLM-based extraction can produce values that must be blindly trusted; CiteLLM addresses this by making every extracted value verifiable against its exact location in the source PDF.
